files.part: camera model, M_from, alternating matrix/curve fit, fit_curve, srgb target
neutral-preserving post-curve matrix fit and Q512 diagonal repair
perceptual refit: per-sample CIEDE2000 residual over look matrix, post matrix and 17-knot curve corrections

changes: Standard library only: banded Cholesky replaces numpy.linalg.solve; a six-term Levenberg-Marquardt with forward differences replaces scipy.optimize.least_squares.
Only sRGB-encoded .cube targets (cube_fit 'srgb' input), exposure offset kept as a parameter; tetrahedral interpolation written locally.
Samples are generated locally (grey ramp, hue wheel, skin tones, random colours); the ColorChecker table, warm boost sets and the 'colour' package are not used.
Base gamma is supplied by the caller at run time from the user's own official firmware (darkslide.base_curve); work/base_gamma_std.npy is not used.
CIEDE2000 written locally for the fit report; no Standard-look comparison (its matrix is not used).

lab_fit refit ported to the standard library: same parameters (6+6+3x17), plain Levenberg-Marquardt with per-parameter steps and a small damping floor instead of scipy least_squares; fewer samples; no ColorChecker or warm-boost sets; the post matrix is rounded to Q512 afterwards without re-solving the curve correction.
